games.title: Dirt Digger
games.description:
A placer gold mining simulator built on real dirt physics.

Stake a claim in wild northern placer country and mine it the way it's really done. Every bucket is real soil: topsoil, clay, gravel and sand that cut, spill, slump and pack down the way they do on a real job, with every cubic metre accounted for.

Strip the overburden with a dozer, dig down to the gravel with a hydraulic excavator, haul it in a dump truck and feed the wash plant with a wheel loader. Water runs through the valley: wet ground turns to mud, and a river you dig in runs muddy downstream. Read the ground, because the gold is where the geology put it.
features: Physics-driven hydraulic machines: excavator, wheel loader, dozer, dump truck
Layered soil that is dug, carried and dumped, with volume conserved
Rivers and creeks that flow, flood your pit and carry silt
A 5-mile claim of boreal valley, built from real placer geology

games.title: Alaskan Bush Simulator
games.description: Fly a taildragger into the Alaskan bush: land on gravel bars and ridgelines, haul supplies to remote camps, and keep yourself alive when the weather closes in and you are a long way from the strip.

accounts.note: Owns nothing; try redeeming a key
